Titles, H1, JSON-LD in first HTML (not an SPA)

findings.title: Canonicals are dynamic (not a launch rewrite)
findings.description: 2026-09-11: 19 WP pages + 631 other 200s are self-canonical on the current host. 0 other host, 0 path mismatch, 0 og≠canonical. ACF seo_canonical is empty where checked. Staging host in tags follows home_url().
findings.recommendation: At cutover set Site Address / WP_HOME / WP_SITEURL to https://londonparkour.com and run search-replace. Do not hard-code londonparkour.com in the theme.

findings.title: Junk pages
findings.description: Recheck 2026-09-11: /sample-page/ is 404 noindex, not in the page sitemap. /clasbpro-theme-preview/ is 200 noindex, nofollow and omitted from wp-sitemap-posts-page-1.xml.
findings.recommendation: Leave clasbpro preview unpublished or delete when convenient.

findings.title: /docs/ hub
findings.description: Recheck 2026-09-11: /docs/ is 200 WordPress (Parkour FAQ & Docs, index, follow). /docs no-slash 301s to HTTPS. FAQ 301s into the hub. public_html/docs was deleted on Cloudways.
findings.recommendation: Keep. Do not redeploy a web-root docs/ folder.

findings.title: Lab LCP still Poor after Helvetica + ClasbPro CSS defer
findings.description: 2026-09-11 14:10 BST: homepage 7.7s (was 7.2; first sample 8.5 discarded). FCP 2.6s. /classes/ 4.4s this run (was 5.0; TTFB 1.2s outlier). Overlay still LCP; Inter and ClasbPro CSS gone from first paint.
findings.recommendation: Next: inline faces.css, Scope Trial woff2 / delay H1 decode. Optionally ClasbPro JS on drawer-open. Do not start an INP project; TBT is already good.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage 1384 main words; about 820; adult/kids class pages pass volume

findings.title: Tutorial unique copy is one sentence
findings.description: deadhang / vault-landing / crouch-walk ledes are a single truncated standard; 609-item filter board inflates word count. Live tutorial sitemaps: ~841 submitted, 0 indexed.
findings.recommendation: Finish the standard as visible HTML. Do not add HowTo schema. Do not expect 609 spokes to index.

findings.title: /classes/ is a timetable, not a service explainer
findings.description: 296 main words. H1 “This week's sessions.” Live UK: 1 click, position 52.5.
findings.recommendation: Keep the timetable. Make outdoor-not-a-gym explicit. Do not chase parkour gym SERPs.

findings.title: JOHN DOE testimonial
findings.description: Homepage quote board includes a placeholder-shaped attribution.
findings.recommendation: Replace with a real review or remove.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Commercial titles unique and mostly 30–60 characters

findings.title: H1s are slogans
findings.description: Homepage H1 does not say parkour, classes, or London. Location H1s are place names only. Titles already carry the query.
findings.recommendation: Do not keyword-stuff against brand voice. Optional: include “parkour classes” in location H1s if design allows.

findings.title: Contact title 22 characters
findings.description: Below the 30-character gate. No tel: on the page.
findings.recommendation: Lengthen the title. Add a phone only if the business wants calls (copy currently prefers email).

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: SportsClub, Course, SportsEvent, Offer, VideoObject present

findings.title: streetAddress is timetable text
findings.description: Vauxhall: “SW8 1SS · VAUXHALL TUBE STATION · SUNDAYS 09:00–12:15"”. Same pattern on Old Street and Kilburn.
findings.recommendation: Real thoroughfare or omit streetAddress. Hours in openingHoursSpecification.

findings.title: logo is a page photo
findings.description: Organization.logo changes per URL (hero, location jpeg, tutorial still, coach portrait).
findings.recommendation: Stable mark on logo. Page photos stay on image / thumbnailUrl.

findings.title: aggregateRating 42 vs on-page 43
findings.description: 4.9/42 emitted on every sampled URL including tutorials.
findings.recommendation: One sourced count, only on the org/homepage, or omit until GBP is verified.

findings.title: FAQPage present
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on 7 May 2026. Class FAQ names are labels, not questions.
findings.recommendation: Do not add new FAQPage for SERP. Do not remove accurate contact Q&A HTML.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: ClasbPro CSS and Inter off first paint; Ken Burns slide 0 only; Leaflet off /

findings.title: Mobile lab LCP Poor
findings.description: Homepage 7.7s, /classes/ 4.4s this run (was 7.2/5.0). No CrUX (API key missing). Live V7 TTFB ~0.95s.
findings.recommendation: Inline faces.css; Scope Trial woff2. Keep slimmer tutorial hub; do not ship 1.48MB /tutorials-category/.

findings.title: Cloudflare AI crawler Disallow
findings.description: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended (Gemini grounding) Disallow: /. Same policy on live V7.
findings.recommendation: Product decision. Google-Extended does not block AI Overviews. Do not lift blocks without discussing training vs grounding.

findings.title: Short citable passages
findings.description: Slogan H1; tutorial ledes truncated; /llms.txt 404 (Google ignores it).
findings.recommendation: Write self-contained 120–160 word answers on class/location pages. Do not add llms.txt for Google ranking.

findings.title: Category hub inlines 391 images
findings.recommendation: Paginate or lazy-link spokes. Keep /tutorials/ hub at ~323 KB.

live_search.note: LIVE V7. Staging not in GSC. Impression deltas vs previous 90d overlap a GSC logging error.
